source). Producer: `fetch_option_instrument_detail` (async, keyed by the
fetched `detail.uly`). Consumed by `recompute_amount_pop` as the index
override so the "≈ value" pop shows while typing. Empty until it lands.

`fetch_option_instrument_detail` fetch. The shared session / option biz

whole reason `fetch_option_instrument_detail` exists), so the per-keystroke
est-value pop derive cannot rely on the biz map for `ct_mult` / `ct_val_ccy`
/ `ct_type` — a miss yields `OptionInstrument::default()` (empty ct_mult →
wrong coin_amt; empty ct_type → CM misclassified). Cache them here so
`recompute_amount_pop_on_handle` builds an accurate InstContext (V1

landing + `refresh_amount_unit`). Empty until the instrument lands.

the OKTradeCore-bound `TradeUnitContractAndOptionBottomSheet`). Option has
exactly two rows — COIN (label = instrument coin symbol, V1
`isShowDetailedCoin=true` used by the option panel) and CONTRACT (CDKey
`pr_options_footer_switch_amount` = Zhang/contract). `is_selected` reflects the live
option trade-unit setting. Native renders the sheet purely from this list
(B1: no OKTradeCore / BizInstrument). Producer:
`recompute_amount_unit_display` (instrument landing + `refresh_amount_unit`
+ `on_amount_unit_changed`). Empty until the instrument lands.

RAW numeric string (same internal-math contract as `sum_available`).

fields.name: sum_available_display
fields.doc:
Available (avail) — ccy by side: BUY -> trade_quote_ccy (e.g. "5,487.83
USDC"; falls back to instrument quote_ccy when trade-with unset),
SELL -> base_ccy. UI-ready `TradingNumber`.

fields.name: sum_max_size_display
fields.doc:
Max tradeable size (max-buy / max-sell) — ccy by side: BUY -> base_ccy
(e.g. "15.640784 ETH"), SELL -> trade_quote_ccy (fallback quote_ccy).
UI-ready `TradingNumber`.

fields.name: loan_available_display
fields.doc:
Loan available — trade_quote_ccy on BUY (spend side; fallback quote_ccy),
base_ccy on SELL. UI-ready `TradingNumber` for the LendAmountLabel row.

fields.name: tgt_ccy
fields.doc: tgtCcy value ("base_ccy" / "quote_ccy") — derived from amt_symbol_type.

fields.name: validation
fields.doc:
Current validation state (SSoT for the submit pipeline).
`validate_input()` returns `PureSpotMarketValidation` on-demand and is
called directly at submit time.

fields.name: amt_tick_size_msg
fields.doc:
Amount lot-size error message (empty = no error). Rust supplies the
raw text; native renders inline (A2 — no Kotlin numeric formatting).

fields.name: market_max_size_exceeded
fields.doc:
Market max-size-exceeded flag (from input-time validation). Native
reads this bool — no Kotlin-side threshold check.

fields.name: trade_quote_ccy_list
fields.doc:
Tradable quote-ccy options for the bound instrument (e.g.
`["USDT", "USDC"]` for a dual-quote USDⓈ pair, empty for a
single-quote pair like BTC-USDT). Sourced from the parent session's
instrument sub-record on every InstrumentChanged / bind
(`SpotInstrument::get_trade_quote_ccy_list`, with `InstrumentDetailData`
preferred over the stub). Drives the V2-native `PureTradeWithSwitchView`
dialog item list + visibility gate (native reads `>1` for show). Sibling
parity: `PureSpotLimitState::trade_quote_ccy_list` (limit/pure/state.rs:979).

fields.name: trade_quote_ccy_icons
fields.doc:
Per-quote-ccy icon URL map for the trade-with switcher picker rows.
Replaces the Kotlin `TradeCoreProxy.getTrade()?.getCoinUrl(ccy)`
thin-UI bridge — the Pure host reads the icon from this state field.

**Producer**: `orchestration::trade_with::resolve_quote_ccy_icons` (mirrors
V1 `getCoinUrl` via `coin_wrapper().get_coin_url`), populated on the same
ticks that write `trade_quote_ccy_list` (initial bind / instrument-only
update / async session bind). Empty before coins are loaded → picker
falls back to text-only rows (native parity). Sibling parity:
`PureSpotLimitState::trade_quote_ccy_icons` (limit/pure/state.rs:1057).

fields.name: spot_only_ccy_list
fields.doc:
Subset of `trade_quote_ccy_list` that does not support margin
borrowing — drives the "spot only" tag on the K-line quick-order
trade-with picker rows. Producer: `spot::common::spot_only_ccy::
compute_trade_with_spot_only_ccys`, populated on the same ticks that
write `trade_quote_ccy_list`. Mirrors the header's
`OktHeaderTradeWithVo.spot_only_ccy_list`.

fields.name: is_trade_receive_supported
fields.doc:
Whether the instrument supports trade-receive quote-ccy switching — true
when `trade_quote_ccy_list.len() > 1`. V1 parity:
`SpotInstrument.is_support_trade_receive()` / the
`TradeWithSwitchView` visibility gate. Native ANDs this with
`trade_quote_ccy_list.size > 1` to reveal the switcher. Sibling parity:
`PureSpotLimitState::is_trade_receive_supported` (limit/pure/state.rs:980).

fields.name: is_order_confirm_open
fields.doc:
User's "ask for confirmation before placing order" preference
(`TradeSettings.get_order_remind_confirm()`). Producer:
`PureSpotMarketInteractor::start` reads `CTRSTrade::trade_setting()`
once on attach. Native reads this for the `MAKE_ORDER_BEFORE_CHECK`
analytics `isConfrimOpen` param (no Kotlin setting read).
Sibling parity: `PureSpotAdvancedLimitState::is_order_confirm_open`
(advanced_limit/pure/state.rs:846).

fields.name: tpsl_config
fields.doc:
Inline OCO TP/SL config SSoT. `None` = checkbox unchecked / TPSL off.
Writer: `update_tpsl_config` / `set_tpsl_enabled` / `clear_tpsl` actions.

fields.name: tpsl_validation_error
fields.doc:
Real-time inline validation result. Derived by
`orchestration::tpsl::validate_tpsl_inline` on every config write.

fields.name: is_tpsl_supported
fields.doc:
Whether TPSL is supported for the current instrument / account.
Writer: `project_instrument_snapshot` / account-config observer.

fields.name: max_avail
fields.doc:
SSoT for the active `fetch_max_available()` pipeline. Native RenderExt
observes this enum (Idle → "--", Loading → "--", Loaded → render the
balance, Error → "--"). The flat fields in partition ⑤ are still
written from the same response so the sum derives keep working.

fields.name: is_logged_in
fields.doc: `user::CoreUserManager::shared().is_login()`.

fields.name: is_spot_inst_type
fields.doc:
Always `true` for this interactor (the market panel is structurally
SPOT). Set once in `start()`. V1 `getInstType() == TRADE_SPOT_TYPE`.

fields.name: is_quick_order
fields.doc:
`true` only for the compact K-line quick-order host. The full market
panel keeps the default `false`; Rust derives consume this classification.

fields.name: is_pm_account
fields.doc:
PM (portfolio-margin) account flag — mirror of V1
`TradeDataSettings.isSpotHedgeEnable()` = `acct_lv == "4"`. Producer:
`start()` reads `CTRSTrade::instance().trade_setting().is_pm_account()`.

fields.name: acct_lv
fields.doc:
Account level string ("1".."5"). Producer: `start()` reads
`CTRSTrade::instance().trade_setting().get_account_level()`. The
generic borrow-help-tips derive fires on the `acct_lv == "1"`
(simple-account / TRADING) branch.

fields.name: is_multiple_account
fields.doc:
V1 `TradeDataSettings.isMultipleAccount()` mirror. SIBLING parity:
the limit interactor has no honest producer for this yet (it is only
ever reset to `false` on logout), so the market kernel likewise
leaves it `false` (do not fabricate a producer the
sibling lacks). The generic borrow-help-tips path therefore fires via
the `acct_lv == "1"` branch only, matching limit's live behavior.

fields.name: is_demo_mode
fields.doc:
Whether the current session is in demo / simulated-trading mode.
Producer: `start()` reads `CTTradeAccountManager::shared().is_demo_mode()`.
Consumed by: `orchestration::balance::derive_support_available_transfer`
(Orchestration must not read global singletons directly).

fields.name: is_auto_borrow
fields.doc:
Whether auto-borrow is enabled for this account.
V1-REF: TradeDataSettings.getAutoLoan() / isAutoBorrow().
Producer: `refresh_borrow_config` (lifecycle tick reads CTRSTrade).
Consumed by: `update_margin_settings` to derive effective is_margin_mode_on
for MULTI/PM accounts (MULTI/PM requires auto-borrow + raw switch on).

fields.name: is_side_support_loan
fields.doc:
Current side's loan-support capability (V1 isSingleSideSupportLoan) —
the second admission channel of the collateral-button gate on pairs
where is_support_margin is false (USDS MCC, e.g. BTC-USD trade-with
USDC). Written by `refresh_side_support_loan` wherever the collateral
derive re-runs; false without a session (standalone hosts).

fields.name: is_spot_order_leader
fields.doc:
V1 `TradeDataSettings.isSpotOrderLeader()` (= `getSpotRoleType() == 1`)
mirror. Producer: `start()` reads `setting.get_spot_role_type()`. Drives
the follower help-dialog leader-vs-copier text branch (consumed by
`OrderLeadDataUtils.getMaxAvailableDialogMgs`). SIBLING parity:
`PureSpotLimitState::is_spot_order_leader`.

fields.name: is_order_leader_spot_position
fields.doc:
Per-instrument lead-trading position flag:
`is_spot_leader() && is_spot_lead_trading_inst_id(inst_id)`. SIBLING
parity: `PureSpotLimitState::is_order_leader_spot_position`. Producers:
`refresh_account_config_mirrors` (start/resume),
`bind_and_fetch_session_instrument` (per-instId re-derive on session
bind), and the close-switch subscription. Feeds the auto-transfer
chevron gate (`derive_support_available_transfer`).

fields.name: is_in_close_switch_list
fields.doc:
Close-switch SSOT membership for the CURRENT instrument. `true` means
this instId's lead switch is CLOSED (R7: the list holds lead-CLOSED
instIds → lead-on = NOT in the list). SIBLING parity:
`PureSpotLimitState::is_in_close_switch_list`. Same three producers as
`is_order_leader_spot_position` above.

fields.name: is_upgrade_btn_visible
fields.doc:
V1 footer Branch-3 (BaseBusinessFragment.initShowSpotFooter :1389):
`isLogin() && !isEnableTrade()` → show upgrade button.
For SPOT, `OkSpotBiz.isEnableTrade()` always returns `true`, so this
is always `false`. Kept for structural parity with SpotAdvancedLimit /
SpotLimit (which read `is_enable_trade` via `update_trade_capability`).
Producer: `start()` — set once as `is_logged_in && !is_enable_trade`
where `is_enable_trade = true` (V1 verified). Sibling:
`SpotAdvancedLimitState::is_upgrade_btn_visible`.

fields.name: is_collateral_btn_visible
fields.doc:
Whether to show the Open Collateral Coin button.
V1-REF: CollateralCoinUtils.getCollateralCoinBtnVisibility:234-238.
Computed by EvaluateCollateralBtnVisibilityUseCase (4 conditions:
whitelist + is_multiple_account + crossed-margin SELL + isCoinNeedOpen).
Producer: update_margin_settings / start().

fields.name: is_questionnaire_btn_visible
fields.doc:
Server-backed questionnaire gate for the current instrument. The code is
kept verbatim so Native can route without inferring business semantics.

fields.name: collateral_ccy_list
fields.doc:
Currencies that need collateral enabled before this order can be placed.
Derived from FormatCcyListUseCase (V1-REF: CollateralCoinUtils.formatCcyList:143).
Empty when is_collateral_btn_visible is false.

fields.name: is_pro
fields.doc:
V1 `TradeCoreProxy.getTradeConfig().isPro()` mirror. Producer: Kotlin
calls `update_is_pro(resolveIsSpotIsPro())` on resume. Drives
`derive_support_available_transfer` (§3 of the 5-AND chevron gate —
only Pro users see the fund-source chevron). SIBLING parity:
`PureSpotLimitState::is_pro` (SpotLimitFragment.kt:1242-1245).

fields.name: is_spot_follower_clickable
fields.doc: Spot-follower / lead clickable-available gate (priority 1).

fields.name: spot_iso_bal_formatted
fields.doc: Formatted `spot_iso_bal` string for the follower help-dialog body.

fields.name: is_spot_hedge_tips_visible
fields.doc: PM spot-hedge help-tips visibility (priority 2).

fields.name: is_available_help_tips_visible
fields.doc: Generic cross-currency borrow "max-spend" help-tips (priority 3).

fields.name: show_max_leverage_help
fields.doc:
Server-authoritative best-leverage affordance for the active max-buy /
max-sell row. Written by the Rust best-leverage request only.

fields.name: is_lend_amount_visible
fields.doc: LendAmount row visibility (native `initTvLendAmount` two branches).

fields.name: lend_amount
fields.doc:
Formatted borrow amount (abs value, truncated + thousand-grouped) — Rust
owns the numeric conversion + precision (A2). Empty → native renders "--".

fields.name: lend_amount_unit
fields.doc: Borrow/lend currency suffix for the LendAmount value (V1 `changeDebtCcy`).

fields.name: borrow_label_kind
fields.doc: Three-state borrow-label copy kind (Potential / Current / Repay).

fields.name: is_trade_account_auto_repay
fields.doc:
V1 `isTradeAccountAutoRepay()` mirror — auto-repay-on-behalf enabled.
Gate input for `derive_is_repay_amount_visible` (borrow-switch-independent).

fields.name: is_repay_amount_visible
fields.doc: Repay-amount row visibility (V1 3-AND; false → row hidden = today's behavior).

fields.name: repay_amount_display
fields.doc: Formatted estimated-repayment amount (abs, truncated + grouped). Empty → "--".

fields.name: repay_amount_unit
fields.doc: Repay-amount currency suffix (V1 totalDebtCcy).

fields.name: min_sz
fields.doc:
Instrument minimum order size, Base-ccy denominated (e.g. "0.00073").
Projected from the bound `SpotInstrument` by `recompute_min_order_hint`.
Native reads it for the AMOUNT-focus min-order-amount hint. Empty until
the instrument is bound (native keeps the hint blank).

fields.name: lot_sz
fields.doc:
Instrument lot size (e.g. "0.0001") — projected from the bound
`SpotInstrument`. Native derives the Base-amount input decimal-places
limit from this (`decimalsOf(lotSz)` → `setDigitalPrecision`); it is the
precision cap for the amount input when the unit is Base. SIBLING:
`PureOKTSpotInstrumentSnapshot::lot_sz` (limit/pure/state.rs). Producer:
`recompute_min_order_hint`.

fields.name: quote_ccy_digit
fields.doc:
Quote-ccy display digit (e.g. 2 for USDT) — projected from the bound
`SpotInstrument` via `market_digit_for_display_ccy`. Native uses it as
the Quote-amount input decimal-places limit (`setDigitalPrecision`) when
the unit is Quote. SIBLING: `PureOKTSpotInstrumentSnapshot::quote_ccy_digit`
(limit). Producer: `recompute_min_order_hint`. 0 until bound (native
falls back to the V1 default 8).

fields.name: min_order_amount_value
fields.doc:
Minimum order amount, Quote-ccy denominated = `min_sz × current_price`
rounded UP to the quote-ccy display digit (Rust owns the multiplication
+ precision — A2). Native reads it for the PROBABLY-focus min-order-total
hint. Empty when `min_sz` / `current_price` is missing / non-positive
(native renders "--"). Producer: `recompute_min_order_hint`. SIBLING:
`limit/.../calculate.rs::min_order_amount`.

fields.name: amount_input_config
fields.doc: Amount input field config (Base/Quote amount box).

fields.name: total_input_config
fields.doc: Probably (Total) input field config.
